gap_fill_decisions: fine signal = the F01 continuation trigger at 5m (the registry gives no fine signal); trend = last completed 1h close vs its 12-hour mean
holding horizon 60 min is deliberately longer than the 30 min fine lookback (signal vs holding horizon kept distinct)
missing_in_source: position-sizing rule (supplied by the EUR 500 capital model of this task)
single outcome horizon (registry lists candidate sets only)
cost model (supplied by the shared harness)
name: FAST -- Multi-Timeframe Trend Alignment

exits: time exit at the first 5m boundary >= signal bar close + 60 min
operationalization.rule: Fine trigger (as F01 but on 5m): LONG candidate if (C_t - C_{t-6}) / (ATR14(5m) * sqrt(6)) >= +1.5 (A3) and the last 5m bar closed up; SHORT mirror. Coarse trend: sign(C_1h - SMA12(1h closes)) from the last COMPLETED 1h bar. Trade only if coarse trend == trigger direction.

source_registry.note: must keep the signal-vs-holding-horizon distinction explicit
source_registry.original_signal_definition: CONCEPT ONLY: a signal on a fine timeframe is filtered/confirmed by trend direction on a coarser derived timeframe (e.g. 5m signal aligned with 1h trend). No formula frozen.
source_registry.required_data: 1-minute canonical FX bars, derived 5m/15m/30m/1h for the coarser confirmation layer.
